brief: 5 gentle morning rituals to start the day grounded.

slots.searchQuery: How to begin the day gently grounded

slots.body: Before you reach for your phone, take three slow breaths and let your shoulders drop away from your ears.
Drink warm water with lemon and feel the quiet gratitude of a body waking without hurry.
Step outside barefoot for two minutes. Let the earth hold you while the sky opens above.
Write three lines in a journal. No edits, no judgment, only honest thoughts spilled gently onto the page.
Stretch your arms overhead and whisper one kind intention before the noise of the world arrives.
You do not need an hour to honor the morning. Five mindful minutes are enough to begin again.

slots.headline: Start slow, stay soft
slots.body: Return to these small practices whenever the world feels too loud. Your peace is always within reach.
